summary: Implemented load_decathlon_datalist in monai/data/utils.py (exported via monai.data). It reads a Decathlon-format JSON file, selects the list under data_list_key (default "training"), requires image and label entries when is_segmentation=True (only image otherwise), supports multi-path image/label lists, resolves relative paths against base_dir (defaulting to the JSON file's directory), and raises ValueError for a missing key, non-dict items, or missing required entries. Added tests/test_load_decathlon_datalist.py covering these cases. Nothing was run and nothing was committed. Docs, notebooks and examples mentioned in the PR were not updated.
